name: Confess
overview: The Bible teaches that confession is essential for receiving God's mercy and forgiveness, as seen in Psalms where David acknowledges and confesses his sins to the Lord, resulting in forgiveness. Proverbs emphasizes that covering sin leads to failure, but confessing and forsaking sin brings mercy. Confession also plays a vital role in salvation, with Romans highlighting the necessity of confessing with the mouth that Jesus is Lord and believing in the heart to be saved. Ultimately, Philippians affirms that every tongue will confess Jesus Christ as Lord, glorifying God the Father.
